title: The Parts Velocity report still lists an inactive part's sales
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active part, part A, for this test.
  • Create a part sale for this test that sold 2 of part A today and is invoiced, so part A has sales to report.
  • Set part A inactive after the sale.
  • Start on the Parts Velocity report (Reports in the top bar, then Parts Velocity).
custom_steps:
1. Set the date range to today.
  2. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The report covers today.

Step 2:

  • Part A is listed with the 2 sold: its history still counts.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S9-E11: “Reports keep inactive parts. Inventory Value and Parts Velocity include them, because their stock still has value and their history still happened.”
